assumptions: Normalized union U={|X+Y|<=1} union {|Y-X|<=1}; rectangles [a,b]x[c,d] have a<b,c<d.
Physical unit normals are (s,c) and (-s,c), c,s>0 and c^2+s^2=1; X=2*s*x/delta and Y=2*c*y/delta.
Length ell=b-a and height H=d-c are normalized coordinate dimensions, not necessarily the rectangle shorter-side width.
All translations but only coordinate-aligned rectangles are allowed; arbitrary rotations are outside this target.
Boundary equality is allowed because both bands and rectangles are closed. Zero height at ell=4 is degenerate, not a positive rectangle.
No surface development, immersion, maximal-strip counting, area theorem, novelty or parent-solution claim.
target: Falsify corner-plus-center sampling for a nonconvex strip union, and certify an exact all-points containment criterion for arbitrary translated axis-aligned rectangles, including its sharp normalized height-versus-length frontier.
